body: Six injection points: Lookuper, EntryObserver (parse), ValueTransformer, CommandRunner, ExpandObserver (expansion), SaveGuard (save, veto only). Three can change a value, two only watch, one only refuses. Every value-changing hook sits in the expansion path, which Render and Save never call. Why: decrypting, vault references, env fallback and secret auditing are other people's policy, so they live outside the package but run inside its pipeline. The firewall is structural, so byte-exact round-trip holds whatever plugins are loaded, and a decrypted secret can never be written back in plaintext. Set/Append/Unset/Restore are deliberately never hooked. All three phases shipped.
title: Plugin model: six hooks with a firewall, change what a value READS as, never what gets WRITTEN
